capabilities: Shows today's goal on a banner and edits it in the note
Lists and ticks tasks from daily notes and Tasks-plugin dates
Displays a read-only ICS calendar on the wall
Shows weather, forecast and air quality in the window
Adds post-its, quotes and ambient music to the room
disambiguation: Not a homepage or start-page plugin; it renders a pixel-art room from your daily notes.
extras: Desktop only (Mac, Windows and Linux), no mobile. Free, no account and no telemetry; every online source has an off switch. A waitlist for future room packs is linked from inside the room.
motivation: The author wanted the second brain to feel like home, since the computer is the only home that followed the user through every move.
problem: Daily notes hold the day's goal and tasks, but Obsidian gives no calm, glanceable view of them.

relations.evidence: If it is installed, Casa respects its global filter and lets it tick its own tasks
The settings files of those plugins are enough: they do not need to be installed or running.
the Journals settings (the first daily journal)

summary: Pixel-art room view that shows today's goal, tasks, calendar and weather read from your daily notes.
